evidence.why: The charge amount is taken directly from the client-supplied 'total' parameter and is never re-derived from server-side cartItems/price data, allowing a client to bill an arbitrary amount.
The order record persists the client-supplied total as the authoritative price rather than a server-computed sum of cartItems quantities and prices.

controls_present: zod schema validation of input shape
ownership predicate (userId) on customer and order lookups
other_classes_observed: Using paymentMethodId as Stripe customer id appears semantically incorrect (functional bug, not security)
